content:
Chris (CEO): Quick weekly — short and actionable. Topline: EU private beta on track but we saw a small routing incident last night; cost target for Q2 is -12% vs current baseline; data retention policy tweak for Private customers needs wide visibility.

Chris (CEO): TL;DR asks — 1) finish EU private GA checklist + KMS sign-off; 2) land cost plan that hits -12% (batching + caching + quant); 3) run a focused postmortem and ship mitigations. :thumbsup:

Marco (Head of Reliability): Incident summary: 02:14-02:32 UTC — EU region degraded. Root cause: fallback routing policy mis-evaluated during a spike, caused ~3% of requests to route to a smaller model variant without proper cache priming, raising p95 latency from 170ms -> 420ms for those requests. No data loss, no customer creds exposed.

Marco (Head of Reliability): Mitigation already applied: rolled back routing change and tightened the fallback gate. Hotfix pushed and verified. Postmortem scheduled for Wed 10:00 UTC.

release-bot: deploy: eu-routing v1.2.3 hotfix deployed by @Marco — CI green, smoke checks passed.

Priya (VP Eng): Autoscaler tweak and fallback gating change rolled. Will run a 3% canary for 48h and then ramp. Also adding an alert rule to catch model-variant fallthroughs earlier.

Priya (VP Eng): Command used for quick restart: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/eu-router --namespace=prod` — that's in the incident runbook.

Asha (VP Product): EU private beta: 5 customers in the onboarding queue this week. Docs checklist green except KMS integration docs and DPA templates — legal needs final sign-off. Recommend delaying GA by one week if KMS E2E not in place.

Sam (Finance): Cost note: current projection with suggested batching and quantization changes = -9% unit cost. We need another ~3% from smarter cache use and request scheduling to hit -12%. I'll sync with infra on plan + expected dates.

Jon (CTO): Engineering plan: ship cache-first routing + KV prefetch to reduce tail latency and token compute. We'll offer an opt-in profile for Dedicated customers to enable more aggressive quantization. ETA: initial rollout in 2 weeks for beta customers.

Chris (CEO): Priorities for next week (ranked): 1) Incident postmortem + immediate actions, 2) KMS E2E + legal sign-off for EU private GA, 3) Cost playbook with measurable owners and milestones.

Chris (CEO): Quick asks for owners — Marco: lead postmortem; Priya & Jon: prioritize cache + autoscaler tasks; Asha: freeze GA comms until KMS confirmed; Sam: finalize cost plan and new targets.

Asha (VP Product): Ack — pausing GA comms until legal/KMS done. I'll update the customer onboarding sheet.

Marco (Head of Reliability): Ack, running postmortem doc, will assign action items and owners before Wed meeting.

Priya (VP Eng): Will slot cache work into next sprint and give status by EOD Friday.

Sam (Finance): I'll circulate the cost sensitivity model + recommended quick wins tomorrow.

Chris (CEO): Thanks team. Let's keep this tight — report back in the leadership sync on Friday. :rocket:
